samples.ru: Здравствуйте! Ваша заявка принята, мы свяжемся с вами в течение одного рабочего дня.

tts.previewNote: A short sample of this voice

languageNote.ka: Georgian: natural prosody, best for support scripts.
languageNote.en: English with a neutral international accent.
languageNote.ru: Russian for customers who prefer it.

tts.tooLong: Text can be at most {{max}} characters.
tts.textPlaceholder: Type what the voice should say...
tts.noVoicesBody: An operator has not enabled a voice for this language yet.
tts.advancedHint: Kept in this tab only. Nothing is saved.
tts.demoNote: Demo: Synthesize plays a pre-recorded sample in the chosen voice. The text you type is not spoken.
tts.presetHint: This model is tuned with one delivery preset.

presetNote.creative: More expressive and varied. Good for storytelling, less predictable on long numbers.
presetNote.natural: Balanced delivery that sounds like a calm agent. The default.
presetNote.robust: Steady and consistent. Best for IVR prompts and anything read word for word.

tts.stabilityHint: Lower is more expressive, higher is more even.
tts.similarityHint: How closely the clip follows the original voice.
tts.styleHint: Adds character; can cost some stability.
tts.boostHint: Sharpens the likeness to the chosen voice.

transcribe.lead: Upload or record a call and get a transcript with the detected language.
transcribe.demoNote: Demo: the transcript is a prepared sample. Your audio stays in the browser and is not uploaded.
transcribe.empty: The transcript appears here after you add audio.

sentiment.lead: Read the same call two ways: what the words say and how the voice sounds.
sentiment.why: A polite sentence can be spoken with tension. Sinji reads the transcript and the voice separately and flags the call when they disagree, instead of blending them into one number.
sentiment.conflictTitle: The words and the voice disagree
sentiment.conflictBody: The wording is courteous but the voice sounds tense. Sinji keeps both readings and marks the call as a conflict, so a reviewer listens before judging.

agreementBody.agree: Both readings point the same way.
agreementBody.partial: One reading is neutral while the other leans positive or negative.
agreementBody.conflict: The readings point in opposite directions.
agreementBody.text_only: No voice reading was available for this audio.
agreementBody.prosody_only: No usable words were found in this audio.
agreementBody.unknown: There was not enough to read.

sentiment.arousalHint: How activated the voice is, from relaxed to intense.
sentiment.valenceHint: How pleasant the voice sounds, from negative to positive.

convert.lead: Convert many recordings to telephony and PBX formats in one batch and download them as one ZIP.
convert.dropHint: Up to {{files}} files, {{file}} each, {{batch}} per batch.
convert.ttl: Converted files stay available for {{days}} days, then they expire.
convert.demoNote: Demo: nothing is uploaded. The ZIP is built in your browser from the files you picked, renamed to the target extension; the audio itself is not re-encoded.

errors.tooMany: A batch holds at most {{n}} files.
errors.batchTooBig: A batch can be at most {{size}} in total.

failures.header: The file ends before the audio header is complete.
failures.codec: The audio stream uses a codec this converter cannot read.
failures.silent: The file is empty or contains only silence.

convert.zipNote: Files are stored as .{{ext}} in an uncompressed ZIP.
convert.zipFailed: Could not build the ZIP. Try again.
convert.noneOk: No file could be converted, so there is nothing to download.

editor.title: Audio editor
editor.lead: Cut, trim, fade and mix recordings right in the browser. Nothing leaves your device.
editor.emptyBody: Drop an audio file here or choose one (up to {{mb}} MB), or try the built-in demo clip.

local.title: Runs in your browser
local.body: Decoding, editing and export all happen on this device.

layers.title: Layers
layers.body: Stack recordings with their own offset, level, mute and solo, then flatten them.

export.title: Export
export.body: Save a WAV, or send the mix through the converter to a telephony format.

editor.decodeFailed: Could not read this audio file.
editor.tooLarge: This file is larger than {{mb}} MB.
editor.needSelection: Select a range first: drag on the waveform, or use Mark in and Mark out.
editor.canvasLabel: Waveform, {{layers}} layer(s), {{duration}} seconds. Arrow keys move the playhead.
editor.canvasHint: Click to place the playhead, drag to select a range. Space plays, I and O mark the range.
editor.cutHint: Remove the selected range and close the gap
editor.scopeHint: Applies to the selection, or the whole layer
editor.fadeHint: Applies to the selection, or 0.5 s at the edge of the layer
editor.normaliseHint: Bring the loudest peak to -1 dB
editor.scopeNote: Silence, reverse, fades, gain, normalise and channel operations use the selected range, or the whole layer when nothing is selected.
editor.layersHint: Each layer has its own start offset and level. Mute and solo are heard instantly.
editor.privacy: Your audio is decoded and edited in this tab only. Telephony export sends a copy through the demo converter, which also stays in the browser.
editor.phoneBody: Mix all audible layers to one WAV and convert it for your PBX.
editor.phoneUses: This uses one conversion. {{remaining}} left today.
